SAMDependency.description: A resource that depends on the resource that a manifest describes.

kind.description: kind[String]: The SAM kind of the resource that depends on this resource, e.g. LLMClient. Read only.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: name[String]: The name of the resource that depends on this resource. Read only.
name.title: Name

SAMDependency.title: SAMDependency

SAMGuardrailMetadata.description: Smarter API Guardrail Manifest - Metadata class.

annotations.description:
The manifest annotations. Used for storing arbitrary metadata as
            key-value pairs. Example: [{'smarter.sh/test-manifest/project-name': 'Scooby dooby do'}]. The
            key should be a valid url-friendly string. The value accepts
            multi-line string values (YAML block scalars) and various scalar types including
            str, int, float, bool, datetime.date, datetime.datetime, decimal.Decimal, uuid.UUID, bytes, list, dict.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource
name.title: Name

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version

SAMGuardrailMetadata.title: SAMGuardrailMetadata

config.description: Guardrail.spec.config[object]. The configuration for the Guardrail.

action.description: Guardrail.spec.config.action[str]: what the guardrail does when it triggers. One of: ['log', 'flag', 'redact', 'transform', 'block', 'escalate'].
action.title: Action

caseSensitive.description: Guardrail.spec.config.caseSensitive[bool]: whether the keyword strategy is case sensitive.
caseSensitive.title: Casesensitive

categories.description: Guardrail.spec.config.categories[list]: the moderation strategy's categories. Empty means all. Any of: ['harassment', 'harassment/threatening', 'hate', 'hate/threatening', 'illicit', 'illicit/violent', 'self-harm', 'self-harm/intent', 'self-harm/instructions', 'sexual', 'sexual/minors', 'violence', 'violence/graphic'].
categories.title: Categories

category.description: Guardrail.spec.config.category[str]: the risk the guardrail addresses. One of: ['pii', 'secrets', 'prompt_injection', 'jailbreak', 'toxicity', 'self_harm', 'hallucination', 'off_topic', 'compliance', 'formatting', 'custom'].
category.title: Category

detectors.description: Guardrail.spec.config.detectors[list]: the detector strategy's detectors. Any of: ['credit_card', 'us_ssn', 'email', 'phone_number', 'ip_address', 'iban', 'aws_access_key', 'private_key', 'api_key', 'jwt', 'password_assignment'].
detectors.title: Detectors

failClosed.description: Guardrail.spec.config.failClosed[bool]: if true, block when the check itself fails, e.g. because the LLM provider is unavailable. If false, the failure is recorded, and the prompt continues.
failClosed.title: Failclosed

flags.description: Guardrail.spec.config.flags[list]: the regex strategy's flags. Any of: ['IGNORECASE', 'MULTILINE', 'DOTALL'].
flags.title: Flags

judgePrompt.description: Guardrail.spec.config.judgePrompt[str]: the llm_judge strategy's prompt, with a {text} placeholder for the text to judge. Any other braces must be doubled, e.g. {{ and }}.
judgePrompt.title: Judgeprompt

keywords.description: Guardrail.spec.config.keywords[list]: the keyword strategy's words and phrases.
keywords.title: Keywords

message.description: Guardrail.spec.config.message[str]: what block returns to the user, instead of the LLM's reply.
message.title: Message

mode.description: Guardrail.spec.config.mode[str]: enforce, to take the action, or monitor, to only record what the action would have been.
mode.title: Mode

model.description: Guardrail.spec.config.model[str]: the model of the semantic, moderation and llm_judge strategies.
model.title: Model

pattern.description: Guardrail.spec.config.pattern[str]: the regex strategy's regular expression.
pattern.title: Pattern

priority.description: Guardrail.spec.config.priority[int]: the order in which guardrails run. Lower runs first.
priority.title: Priority

provider.description: Guardrail.spec.config.provider[str]: the name of the Smarter LLM Provider that the semantic, moderation and llm_judge strategies call. Defaults to openai.
provider.title: Provider

referenceTexts.description: Guardrail.spec.config.referenceTexts[list]: the semantic strategy's examples of what to detect.
referenceTexts.title: Referencetexts

replacement.description: Guardrail.spec.config.replacement[str]: what redact and transform replace each match with. Defaults to [REDACTED], which an empty replacement also means. {label} is replaced with what matched, e.g. credit_card. For the regex strategy, transform may refer to groups, e.g. \1.
replacement.title: Replacement

severity.description: Guardrail.spec.config.severity[int]: from 1 (low) to 5 (critical), for reporting and review.
severity.title: Severity

stage.description: Guardrail.spec.config.stage[str]: when the guardrail runs. One of: ['input', 'output', 'both'].
stage.title: Stage

strategy.description: Guardrail.spec.config.strategy[str]: how the guardrail detects. One of: ['regex', 'keyword', 'detector', 'semantic', 'moderation', 'llm_judge'].
strategy.title: Strategy

threshold.description: Guardrail.spec.config.threshold[float]: the minimum confidence, from 0 to 1, at which the semantic, moderation and llm_judge strategies trigger. Defaults to 0.8.
threshold.title: Threshold

wholeWord.description: Guardrail.spec.config.wholeWord[bool]: whether the keyword strategy matches whole words only.
wholeWord.title: Wholeword

SAMGuardrailStatus.description:
Smarter API Guardrail Manifest - Status class.

Read only. Besides ownership, it reports the guardrail's events of the last 30 days. The
LLMClients that use it are reported in ``dependencies``.

accountNumber.description: Guardrail.status.account_number: The account owner of this Guardrail. Read only.
accountNumber.title: Accountnumber

blocked.description: Guardrail.status.blocked: how many prompts this Guardrail blocked in the last 30 days. Read only.
blocked.title: Blocked

created.description: The date in which this resource was created. Read only.
created.title: Created

dependencies.description: dependencies[List]: The resources that depend on this resource, and that must be deleted, or stop referring to it, before it can be deleted. Lists only the resources that you can read. Read only.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

errors.description: Guardrail.status.errors: how many times this Guardrail failed to run in the last 30 days. Read only.
errors.title: Errors

lastTriggered.description: Guardrail.status.lastTriggered: when this Guardrail last triggered. Read only.
lastTriggered.title: Lasttriggered

modified.description: The date in which this resource was most recently changed. Read only.
modified.title: Modified

recordLocator.description: recordLocator[String]: An optional identifier used to locate the resource record associated with this manifest. Read only.
recordLocator.title: Recordlocator

triggered.description: Guardrail.status.triggered: how many times this Guardrail triggered in the last 30 days. Read only.
triggered.title: Triggered

username.description: Guardrail.status.username: The Smarter user who created this Guardrail. Read only.
username.title: Username

SAMGuardrailStatus.title: SAMGuardrailStatus

apiVersion.title: Apiversion

kind.title: Kind
